cues: But a shift was occurring by the nineteen nineties.
Students ignored the shelves and found what they needed on computers, so the college decided to get rid of the books.
Visiting a couple of months ago, he was horrified: the once overflowing shelves were nearly empty, the books thrown out with remarkably little objection.
It felt like a murder, a crime, the destruction of centuries of knowledge.
